sourceText:
Humdingers(For Christmas)
By: jade summer cook
Published: Thursday, December 23, 2010 - 2:35pm

Ingredients




1/2 cup butter (1 stick) shopping list
8 oz pkg Chopped dates shopping list
1 cup sugar shopping list
1 1/2 cups Rice Krispies shopping list
1 cup powder sugar shopping list

Preparation

1 Over medium heat, combine butter, dates, and sugar. 2 Stir continuiously! 3 Cook 5 minutes until well blended. 4 Remove from heat. 5 Stir in Rice Krispies - mixture will be THICK! 6 Shape into small balls - (Keep in mind, they are VERY sweet and rich!!) 7 Roll in powder sugar and place on a sheet of wax paper. 8 Cool completely before storing in air-tight container IF you any left!

Comments:
jade summer cook

Enjoy
